Public GPL-3.0 synthetic plaintext export used to verify URI-list compatibility.

The encrypted sample is a public synthetic test fixture from the Proton
Authenticator project, distributed under GPL-3.0. Its test password is
`password`; its reduced KDF parameters are intended only for testing.
Source: https://github.com/ProtonMail/proton-authenticator/tree/main/proton-authenticator/test_data/authenticator/ente
